raw:
@q query
  where all
    match
      relation "be old"
      role subject "Ms Gupta"
      role object ?age1
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be old"
      role subject "Ms Anghel"
      role object ?age2
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  compare ?age1 above ?age2
